intro.text: A kandra of the Third Generation, born in the Final Empire's third century, who was present when the first kandra Contracts were drawn up.
A Third Generation kandra once contracted to Straff Venture, who broke his Contract by sharing the kandra's secrets with Vin and stood trial in the kandra Homeland.
A veteran kandra famed as his people's finest impersonator, who carries out tasks for Harmony and guides Waxillium Ladrian to the kandra Homeland.

items.text: TenSoon was born in the third century of the Final Empire, part of the Third Generation of kandra. The kandra tried to live among humans, but people feared their abilities and hunted them. Facing extinction, the kandra offered their services instead, and TenSoon was there when the first service Contracts were drawn up.
TenSoon's Contract was held by Lord Straff Venture. Returning from a ball, Elend Venture once found his father in his office talking with TenSoon, who was wearing the body of a House Hasting servant.

Zane Venture used TenSoon to replace OreSeur, Vin's kandra companion. TenSoon killed OreSeur, took his Blessing of Potency and kept Kelsier's bones, and served Vin in the body of a wolfhound, a form he came to like.

TenSoon broke the Contract by telling Vin the kandra's secrets and by disobeying Zane, his master. He returned to the kandra Homeland, where he was imprisoned alongside ChanGaar and put on trial. He rebelled and escaped to go to Vin's aid.

Unable to reach Luthadel and in despair, TenSoon turned back to the Homeland in time to help free Sazed from the Second Generation's treachery. Wearing the true body of a Fifth Generation guard, he fooled KanPaar until Ruin seized his body and began choking Sazed, forcing TenSoon to remove his own Blessings and become a mistwraith.

TenSoon was restored, though his memories of the time before his spikes came out were degraded after more than an hour without them. Kandra came to call his deeds the Remarked Duplicity, and he became known among them as the best impersonator of all and for how quickly he could change bodies.

When Captain Brettin was killed in an unrelated matter, Harmony had TenSoon take his place, an imperfect impersonation since TenSoon had never studied the man. As Brettin, he filed a backdated request granting Waxillium Ladrian a citywide deputized forbearance, clearing him of charges from his hunt for the Vanishers and giving him powers of arrest. After Miles Dagouter's execution, "Brettin" retired.

During the hunt for Paalm, TenSoon met Wax as a huge wolfhound, changing to human form and back within seconds, to guide him to the kandra Homeland for information on Bleeder. He helped Wax escape chimeras through the remains of the Pits of Hathsin.

During the Set's attack on Elendel, Steris revealed that Constable Gorglen was TenSoon in disguise. He served as a go-between for the Southern Scadrians and the Elendel council, decided to fetch the Bands of Mourning to try to stop the bomb, and stayed with Governor Varlance and Steris to evacuate the harbor and city after the senators and vice-governor fled.

appearance.text: TenSoon often wears the body of a wolfhound, a form he came to like while serving Vin.
Used to four legs, TenSoon moves awkwardly in human form, and even then speaks in a rough, gravelly voice.

personality.text: After a millennium as a spy and impostor, TenSoon can mimic someone so well that even their closest friends cannot tell, and no kandra can match the speed with which he changes bodies.
TenSoon tends to growl at others, and after the Catacendre he has fallen out of practice at talking with people.
